places.raw_name: wet thickets where the herd ended the night
places.name: Stampede ground south of the Nueces
places.note: At dawn the herd is gathered with few losses, the wagon is pulled from a gully, and hands dry out while Deets goes to look for the missing Gus.
places.location_hint: puddled mesquite brush a short distance south of the Nueces crossing; part of the herd a mile or two east

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Call wants to cross soon; Dish scorns it as barely a creek while Jasper fears being trampled in it.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Dish jokes the missing Gus has gone there for a shave.

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: The hands argue over how many rivers lie between them and it; Needle says the bull won't live to cross it if he charges again.
